title: passiflora hassleriana var. paraguariensis
intro: Passiflora hassleriana var. paraguariensis, commonly known as the Paraguayan passionflower, is a plant species that belongs to the Passifloraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of P. hassleriana var. paraguariensis include acting as a nervine, antispasmodic, and sedative, making it a potential treatment for restlessness, muscle spasms, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic effects.
